evidence: We have developed pilot programs to implement certain third-party generative artificial intelligence (AI) and predictive analytics tools into our systems for specific purposes.
These tools presently include, without limitation, (i) a knowledge retention tool, (ii) a risk assessment tool and (iii) a virtual assistant tool.

There is a risk that such AI tools (or AI tools used without Company approval) will be used in a manner that does not adhere to our AI policy and/or may be misused by our employees, vendors, or other third parties engaged by us.
the increased prevalence and use of artificial intelligence may heighten the risk that we may be subject to cybersecurity incidents in the future.
ai_positioning.summary: GVA intègre des outils IA tiers (génératifs et analytiques prédictifs) dans ses systèmes via des programmes pilotes, tout en adoptant une approche prudente face aux risques de sécurité et de conformité associés.
